svg.aria-label: Five steps of Task 1.2. Step 1, review the export: provisioning exported the Service Desk data from Microsoft Dataverse to the Blob container servicedesk-export, one JSON file per document. Step 2, create the index servicedesk-knowledge with the key id, the citation fields title, url and sourceId, the content field and a vector field. Step 3, load and count: the indexer servicedesk-export-indexer, with the skillset servicedesk-embed-skills and the embedding model text-embedding-3-small, loads the documents, and the count matches the export manifest. Step 4, add the index to msp-support-agent as a knowledge source. Step 5, ask and check citations: the answer cites KB0058 with a link to the record. A terminal types C:\LabFiles\tools\New-KnowledgeIndex.ps1 with illustrative output. A note shows an ambiguous case: KB0031 and KB0058 describe the same symptom, and Woodgrove Bank's product versions select KB0058.
